description: Source code for the lexical analyzer component of Lua, implementing tokenization and string parsing functions.

methods.name: luaX_init
methods.description: Initializes reserved keywords and environment name in Lua state.

methods.name: luaX_token2str
methods.description: Converts token codes to their string representations.

methods.name: luaX_syntaxerror
methods.description: Reports a syntax error with a message.

methods.name: luaX_newstring
methods.description: Creates and interns a new string in the scanner's table.

methods.name: luaX_setinput
methods.description: Sets up the lexical analyzer input source and initializes scanner state.

methods.name: luaX_next
methods.description: Advances to the next token in the input stream.

methods.name: luaX_lookahead
methods.description: Peeks at the next token without consuming it.
